caption: Fig. 2.13 (a) Probability density plots of 1s and 2s atomic orbitals. The density of the dots represents the probability density of finding the electron in that region. (b) Boundary surface diagram for 1s and 2s orbitals.
note: Two rows of artwork: row (a) is the dot probability-density pair, row (b) the boundary-surface pair; each row carries its own "1s" (left) and "2s" (right) label beneath the artwork, so "1s" and "2s" each appear twice and the flat list cannot show which row they belong to. Labels listed row by row, left then right. Excluded from the grown crop (outside target_box_in_crop): the running header "CHEMISTRY", the left-hand column body text, and the yellow panel beginning below the caption whose "2p_x" / "2p_y" labels belong to the next figure.
